text: `TestHelpContracts.test_top_level_help_includes_global_contract` expects `og.main(['--help'])` to return code `0` and print a usage line containing `og [--json] [--strict] [--non-interactive] [--profile analyze|propose|apply] [--mode observe|autonomous] <command>`, plus `--non-interactive`, `Use: og <command> --help for command-specific contracts.`, and `Core commands:`.
